posts.body:
Hi, our little one is 8m old now and I think its time to ditch our graco symbian travel pram for a more light weight stroller which will also take up less room.

Has anyone here got any recommendations? Max budget about a 100 pounds.

posts.body: We've got this really sturdy, lovely to push, easy fold and comfy for baby to sleep in. Really glad I bought this one as lots of friends have gone through 4/5 strollers to try and find the right one.

posts.body:
We have a baby jogger - Love it! It folds completely flat, wheels can be removed too (easy to wash them when we've been through mud etc on the park!) http://www.babyjogger.co.uk/citymini.php

You could get a second hand one from eBay within your budget

posts.body:
I bought the Zeta Vooom brand new for £60. It's one of my best buys to date to be honest as it was much, much better than I ever expected for the price.

You can read a detailed review on it here: http://www.squidoo.com/i-love-the-zeta-vooom

Hope this helps!
